reply_text: @Gideon Sato: the first report in #inc-vtg-hartford was at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug**, your post saying the gate kiosks were offline at the Hartford plant with both inbound lanes showing a white screen after badge scan. The channel records the guard writing trailer numbers on a clipboard at that point. Between then and the 11:03 kiosk 1 recovery, the channel has nothing else about the guard. At 11:03 Mateo noted that the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it. I can only see what was posted here, so anything the guard did that wasn't reported in this channel isn't in this record.
